notes.claim: To factorise x² + bx + c into two brackets, the two numbers must add to b and multiply to c.

sources.title: How to factorise an expression - GCSE Maths Revision - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: To factorise the quadratic 𝑥² + 𝑏𝑥 + 𝑐, the sum of the two numbers in the brackets must be 𝑏, and the product must be 𝑐.
